title: Wrestling Above the Clouds
paras: At the mountain village of Darun, travellers arriving for the autumn wrestling festival share the climbing path with families making a [[pilgrimage|pilgrimage]] to a hilltop shrine. Prayer flags hang above the wrestling ground, but the contests are governed by precise secular rules: a throw is [[legitimate|legitimate]] only if neither competitor has seized the other's clothing.

This distinction may [[intrigue|intrigue]] visitors expecting an unrestricted test of strength. Before the opening match, Levan, a retired wrestler and an [[eloquent|eloquent]] interpreter of village traditions, explains that restraint is the [[essence|essence]] of the sport. Although guests may join morning practice, the festival competition admits only wrestlers who have completed the village's training programme, regardless of their reputation elsewhere.

Behind the arena, cooks and competitors [[collaborate|collaborate]] on preparations that receive little applause. In the guesthouse [[pantry|pantry]], sacks of barley stand beside jars of dried apricots; both will supply the communal supper. A wrestling [[fanatic|fanatic]] might consider kitchen duty a distraction, yet every entrant takes a turn. Levan regards this obligation as a reminder that physical distinction confers no exemption from ordinary work.

By late afternoon, the repeated pauses for sweeping grit from the wrestling mats can seem [[tiresome|tiresome]]. Nevertheless, this [[commonsense|commonsense]] precaution reduces the risk of slipping, and spectators settle patiently along the wall. When the final bout ends, the winner carries benches rather than accepting a victory parade.
zh: 在山村达伦，前来参加秋季摔跤节的旅行者，与前往山顶神庙朝圣的家庭共走一条上山小路。经幡悬挂在摔跤场上方，但比赛遵循的是明确的世俗规则：只有双方都未抓住对手衣物时完成的摔投，才算合乎规则。
这一差别可能会引起游客的好奇，因为他们原本以为这是一场不受限制的力量较量。首场比赛开始前，退役摔跤手莱万以富有感染力的语言解说村庄传统，指出克制才是这项运动的精髓。尽管来客可以参加晨练，节日期间的正式比赛却只允许完成本村训练课程的摔跤手参加，无论他们在其他地方名气多大。
赛场后方，厨师与选手协作完成那些鲜获掌声的筹备工作。旅舍的食品储藏室里，一袋袋大麦紧挨着一罐罐杏干，两者都将用于集体晚餐。摔跤狂热爱好者或许觉得厨房杂务会让人分心，但每位参赛者都要轮流值班。莱万认为，这项义务提醒着人们：体能出众，并不意味着可以免做日常劳动。
到了傍晚前后，为清扫摔跤垫上的砂砾而反复暂停比赛，可能显得令人厌烦。然而，这种合乎常识的预防措施能够降低滑倒的风险，观众也便耐心地沿墙坐定。最后一场较量结束后，获胜者没有接受列队欢庆，而是动手搬起长凳。

q.s: Wrestlers with established reputations elsewhere can compete without completing local training.
q.why: 第二段明确规定，名气再大也须完成本村训练。

q.s: Each entrant spends an hour on kitchen duty.
q.why: 文中说明每位选手轮值，但未给出值班时长。

q.s: The winner helps carry benches after the final bout.
q.why: 末段明确写到最后一场结束后胜者搬长凳。
